title: The Fish That Fuses With Its Mate
description:
Some fish physically fuse with their mates.

In Cryptopsaras couesii, the triplewart seadevil, a tiny male can attach permanently to a much larger female. Their tissues and blood vessels connect over time. He receives nutrients while remaining an identifiable, reproductive male.

Not all anglerfish do this. Lasting attachment may help when encounters are rare.

Original AI-generated biological reconstruction; fusion is time-compressed. Synthetic narration; original sound.

Sources:
https://www.nature.com/articles/256038a0
https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaz9445
https://doi.org/10.1098/rspb.2026.1268
